funding.name: New York Tuition Assistance Program (TAP)
funding.provider: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
funding.provides: A state grant to help cover tuition expenses for eligible New York students attending full-time, part-time or as non-degree students.
funding.eligibility: Legal NYS resident for 12 continuous months before enrolling (or NYS DREAM Act eligible); net taxable income no more than $125,000 for dependent students, $60,000 for married independent students with no dependents, or $30,000 for independent single students with no dependents.
funding.amount: $1,000 to $5,665 (per the page; determined by income, family size and financial status)
funding.how_to_apply: Apply through the FAFSA and the TAP application each year.

funding.name: New York Excelsior Scholarship
funding.provider: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
funding.provides: Lets students from families earning $125,000 or less attend a state-operated SUNY or CUNY college tuition-free; it is a last-dollar scholarship applied after PELL, TAP and other tuition-applicable aid.
funding.eligibility: Household combined federal adjusted gross income of $125,000 or less; undergraduate degree at a SUNY or CUNY college; enroll full time and complete at least 30 credits per year; FAFSA and TAP application each year.
funding.amount: Covers remaining tuition at a SUNY or CUNY college, per the page
funding.how_to_apply: Apply through the FAFSA and TAP/DREAM Act application each year.

funding.name: New York Enhanced Tuition Award (ETA)
funding.provider: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
funding.provides: Up to $6,000 in tuition assistance for students at participating private colleges, combining TAP, ETA and a private college match.
funding.eligibility: Household combined federal AGI of $125,000 or less; undergraduate at a participating private college; full-time study (at least 12 credits); U.S. citizen or eligible noncitizen.
funding.amount: Maximum of $6,000 per year (per the page)
funding.how_to_apply: Complete the FAFSA and the TAP application each year.
